set.body: Make the already verified image4s, reframe4s, and ScalaFIM image-unification work durable in the canonical repositories. Preserve concurrent dirty work and active reservations. Acceptance: provider commits are reachable from canonical local refs; ScalaFIM integration is rebased onto local main and retested on JVM+JS; no remote push without explicit authorization.
set.title: Land verified image/provider unification on canonical local main lines
